ATOMIC_PUBLICATION: exclusive key reservation; never overwrite claim; partial record remains unusable; not a claim of whole-file atomicity
CHECK_AUTHORITY: Prospective bounded basic preflight before coordinator APIs: exact resource/observer boundaries and fresh single-campaign authority must be established first; successful preflight establishes store predicates, not a prerequisite of already-verified store predicates.90 conditional scope must be authenticated at entry; no check executed in96.
CLEANUP_POLICY: retain all consumption, audit, crash and helper output; no deletion/reset during campaign or recovery; later disposal needs separate bounded policy
CONFLICT_REJECTION: exclusive activation and fixed test/variant directories; same grant/key for deliberate duplicates, otherwise unique inputs/stores
CRASH_RECOVERY: missing/partial/conflicting/ambiguous claim returns no launch/retry; consumed persists; no power-loss guarantee inferred
DIRECTORY_FSYNC: require successful parent directory fsync before eligibility
DURABLE_EVIDENCE_RETENTION: root and children survive failed/unknown campaign; fail-closed publication failures retain available primary/secondary evidence
EXCLUSIVE_CREATE_SEMANTICS: O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW permanent reservation; no check-then-create; existing identical, incomplete or conflicting claim denies
FILESYSTEM_TYPE: exact future filesystem/device/mount options UNDETERMINED; current mount inventory retained separately
FILE_FSYNC: require complete bounded write then successful file fsync
INDEPENDENT_REREAD: separate readonly fd, exact canonical bytes, content identity and inode; externally pinned store device/inode; confirmation cannot mint a transferable token
INPUT_INSTANCE_RULE: after separately permitted creation independently bind store dev/inode, epoch raw pin and exact runtime entry, validate against sealed logical basis; reject unknown values
OUTPUT_ACCOUNTING: include fixture preparation, entry/proof documents if written in campaign, all writes/overwrites, witness/audit/budget rewrites and stdout/stderr capture; no uncharged paths
